title: Autonomous Ground Navigation and Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance for Husky Robot in Pedestrian Areas
SLAM in Low-Light Environments: Project Report
meta: Benchmarking visual SLAM systems under low-light conditions
summary: We evaluate six visual SLAM systems — feature-based, direct, filter-based, and learning-based — on low-illumination sequences. Only pipelines combining inertial fusion with global optimization tracked reliably in the dark; RGB-only methods struggled, pointing to low-light-specific algorithms or added sensors as the way forward.
